summary: This survey covers instructional activity and unduplicated enrollment at eligible IPEDS postsecondary institutions over either July 1, 2003–June 30, 2004 or September 1, 2003–August 31, 2004, with each institution choosing one period. It reports institution-level activity for undergraduate and graduate students; before 2007, these 12-month data were collected on the Fall Enrollment survey form.

Fall Enrollment reports institution-level student counts for eligible IPEDS postsecondary institutions. Traditional academic-year institutions report enrollment as of October 15 or their official fall reporting date; institutions with program-specific or continuous calendars report students enrolled at any time from August 1 through October 31. Tables contain multiple records per institution, with each record defined by the table’s specified student characteristics; some components have restricted populations or optional reporting.

The Finance component covers institutions’ fiscal years ending in 2004 and is reported during the Finance collection window for the 2004 reporting cycle. Its universe is Title IV-eligible postsecondary institutions; degree-granting institutions report annually, while non-degree-granting institutions report only in odd-numbered years, so non-degree-granting institutions have no required Finance data for 2004 (an even-numbered year). Data are reported under the institution’s applicable accounting standard, with separate treatment of public GASB institutions and their component units.

The Graduation Rates survey reports outcomes for cohorts of full-time, first-time degree- or certificate-seeking undergraduate students at eligible Title IV postsecondary institutions, with student status measured as of August 31, 2004. It covers completion and transfer outcomes through 150 percent of normal time, using institution sector and students’ degree-seeking status to define the applicable cohort. Results are reported by institutions for the relevant cohort populations rather than for all enrolled students.

Human Resources data cover staff and employees at IPEDS institutions, using a fall 2004 payroll snapshot as of November 1; salary and fringe-benefit tables cover academic year 2004-05. The unit of observation is an institution-level staff or employee category, with eligibility varying by institution type and size as noted for individual tables. Reporting race/ethnicity and gender was optional in even-numbered years, so 2004 (even) is an optional-reporting year and those data may be missing for many institutions.

Institutional Characteristics is collected for the 2004-05 academic year during the annual IPEDS collection cycle. The unit of observation is the postsecondary institution, and the universe includes institutions in the 2004 IPEDS universe; Title IV participation and other institutional eligibility or status indicators are reported rather than making every table Title IV-only. Reporting covers institutional characteristics, offerings, admissions, services, charges, and related directory and status information.
